bio.text: Christina Bohannan, a University of Iowa College of Law professor and former member of the Iowa House of Representatives, announced in June 2025 that she would run for Iowa's 1st Congressional District in 2026.
She previously ran for the seat in 2022 and 2024; in 2024 Republican Mariannette Miller-Meeks was reelected over her by just under 800 votes.

According to her campaign website, she earned a degree in environmental engineering, worked as an engineer specializing in water quality, graduated first in her class from law school, and has taught at the University of Iowa College of Law for 26 years.
According to the same website, she was elected to the Iowa House in 2020.

sources.title: Christina Bohannan launches bid for 1st Congressional District seat
